Container.Name: ChannelFlow
Container.Overview: ChannelFlow-Server — simulated live TV for Jellyfin (channels, EPG, commercials, native WeatherStar, and news). Pair with the ChannelFlow plugin. Mount the same media share Jellyfin uses, then set path remaps in the Web UI. PostgreSQL can be configured in the Web UI on first launch, or set POSTGRES_* if the database is already on the Docker network.
Container.Requires: A PostgreSQL server ChannelFlow can reach (configure in the Web UI on first launch, or with POSTGRES_*). Jellyfin with the ChannelFlow plugin.

Config.Name: Web UI
Config.Description: ChannelFlow Web UI, admin API, M3U/XMLTV, and live streams

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Config, logos, logs, caches, weather/news working files (CHANNELFLOW_CONFIG). Logs are in logs/channelflow-YYYYMMDD.log

Config.Name: Media
Config.Description: Same library share Jellyfin uses; remap Jellyfin prefixes to /media in Settings

Config.Name: Intel GPU
Config.Description: Pass /dev/dri for Intel VAAPI encode and decode

Config.Name: TZ
Config.Description: IANA time zone for the container clock, log timestamps, and midnight jobs. Use the same zone as General → schedule time zone (e.g. America/Chicago, America/New_York).

Config.Name: Jellyfin URL
Config.Description: Jellyfin base URL on the shared Docker network

Config.Name: Postgres Host
Config.Description: Optional. Leave empty to configure PostgreSQL in the Web UI on first launch. Set this to skip the wizard (e.g. postgres on the Docker network).

Config.Name: Postgres Port
Config.Description: PostgreSQL port when POSTGRES_HOST is set

Config.Name: Postgres Database
Config.Description: Database name when POSTGRES_HOST is set

Config.Name: Postgres User
Config.Description: Database user when POSTGRES_HOST is set

Config.Name: Postgres Password
Config.Description: Database password when POSTGRES_HOST is set. Leave empty to enter it in the Web UI.

Config.Name: FFmpeg path
Config.Description: Path to ffmpeg inside the container

Config.Name: FFmpeg HWAccel
Config.Description: vaapi for Intel Quick Sync, or leave empty for software

Config.Name: FFmpeg VAAPI device
Config.Description: VAAPI render node inside the container

Config.Name: Public URL
Config.Description: Public origin for M3U/XMLTV when reverse-proxied, e.g. https://channelflow.example.duckdns.org

Config.Name: Path base
Config.Description: Only if the UI is under a subpath, e.g. /channelflow
